limits: Per-processor curated callback ownership and actual routing are native prerequisites, not a new independently installable component or completed auth/catalog extraction.
No process-final registry closing state or global callback drain exists in this slice. Final closure must linearize against newly registered scopes; snapshot-only drain is insufficient.

No final host integration or shutdown repair is claimed. Standalone and combined binaries must invoke cleanup on success, error and early-return paths before their runtimes end, with one absolute shared deadline.

Native sync still captures the original manager/callback. Closing embedded A and keeping B locally open does not deliver completion to B. Generation/home-aware subscriptions, transfer/replay and completion-versus-registration race tests remain required.

Observation completion covers exact registered actions, not best-effort failures logged by callees. MCP invalidation requests refresh; it does not prove session prewarm has terminated. Subsequent session shutdown remains required.
Generic remote/marketplace callbacks, remote trust/config queues and immediate account-change refresh keep their existing routes and are outside the curated scope.

Cancelled/failed/pending records retain custody. Deadline checks do not establish a universal hard bound for arbitrary synchronous action factory/poll or payload work; no detached cleanup or new force policy is introduced.

Combined core-plugins/App Server --lib attempt02 passed 953 tests after an unchanged-source retry; failed linker attempt01 remains separate. Scope-only intermediate publication was not separately runtime-tested.
No full CLI, installed-package, GUI, in-app Browser, live-provider, held native Git/HTTPS, process-final/slow-shutdown or replacement propagation acceptance has run for this candidate.
Passing source922 CLI/storage/migration/GUI evidence and source27d native-completion tests remain separate source-specific checkpoints.
C2b archive extraction, repository/SHA recovery journal, host-death fencing, all remaining component extraction and installed maintenance/upstream integration/rollback remain incomplete.

Frozen archives and snapshots are cloud-local recovery checkpoints. Sixteen final source blobs were read back from the two remote source commits; evidence-child creation and branch advancement require their separate publication receipt.

Curated native Rust callback signatures intentionally change to CuratedSyncCallback and require rebuilt compiled callers. No component wire contract, package manifest, SDK compatibility version or independently installed callback provider is added by this slice.

Exact custody and termination of MCP refresh/prewarm descendants is a next gate. A callback awaiting invalidation or best-effort config reload does not establish all delegated work is joined. Registry admission fencing, replacement delivery and binary process-final authority must be verified together before a clean whole-host shutdown claim.
